source_identity.documented_scope: SVL of 1233 New World anuran species

archive_handling.if_zip: List archive members; select exactly one workbook whose basename matches SVL_Amadoetal2018.xlsx. If absent or duplicated, fail closed.
archive_handling.no_other_file_values: Do not inspect numerical trait values beyond structural detection of an SVL-like column.

allowed_outputs: archive member names and selected workbook name
workbook sheet names, row counts, column names
exact/frozen-alias species-name coverage among the fixed 29 NAAMP species
prohibited_outputs: any change to the fixed 29-species response family
usable_if: one unique workbook has a species-name column matching >=15 of 29 fixed species and an unambiguous SVL-like numeric column
stop_if: no transport succeeds, archive identity is ambiguous, or coverage <15
